name: XZF-SC
about: XZF-SC (2020-027A), a crewed vehicle (XZF), launched 2020 May  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2020 May  5), held fixed
GCAT names the site (Jiuquan) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
